grid.expression: SELECT ITE.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, CAB.DTENTSAI, CAB.AD_NUMPS AS PLANO, PRC.NROLOTE, ITE.CODLOCALORIG, LOC.DESCRLOCAL, SER.SERIE, (CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(S.SERIE) FROM TGFSER S INNER JOIN TGFITE I ON I.SEQUENCIA=S.SEQUENCIA AND I.NUNOTA=S.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFCAB C ON C.NUNOTA=S.NUNOTA WHERE S.SERIE=SER.SERIE AND C.TIPMOV = 'F') = 7 THEN 'Apontada e Conferida Expedição' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(S.SERIE) FROM TGFSER S INNER JOIN TGFITE I ON I.SEQUENCIA=S.SEQUENCIA AND I.NUNOTA=S.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFCAB C ON C.NUNOTA=S.NUNOTA WHERE S.SERIE=SER.SERIE AND C.TIPMOV = 'F') = 6 AND ITE.CODLOCALORIG = 109 THEN 'Conferida na expedição porem não apontada na montagem final' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(S.SERIE) FROM TGFSER S INNER JOIN TGFITE I ON I.SEQUENCIA=S.SEQUENCIA AND I.NUNOTA=S.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFCAB C ON C.NUNOTA=S.NUNOTA WHERE S.SERIE=SER.SERIE AND C.TIPMOV = 'F') = 6 THEN 'Apontada ate o setor Montagem final' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(S.SERIE) FROM TGFSER S INNER JOIN TGFITE I ON I.SEQUENCIA=S.SEQUENCIA AND I.NUNOTA=S.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFCAB C ON C.NUNOTA=S.NUNOTA WHERE S.SERIE=SER.SERIE AND C.TIPMOV = 'F') = 5 THEN 'Apontada ate o setor de teste' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(S.SERIE) FROM TGFSER S INNER JOIN TGFITE I ON I.SEQUENCIA=S.SEQUENCIA AND I.NUNOTA=S.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFCAB C ON C.NUNOTA=S.NUNOTA WHERE S.SERIE=SER.SERIE AND C.TIPMOV = 'F') = 4 THEN 'Apontada ate o setor de tampa e gabinete' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(S.SERIE) FROM TGFSER S INNER JOIN TGFITE I ON I.SEQUENCIA=S.SEQUENCIA AND I.NUNOTA=S.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFCAB C ON C.NUNOTA=S.NUNOTA WHERE S.SERIE=SER.SERIE AND C.TIPMOV = 'F') = 3 THEN 'Apontada ate o setor de dissipador' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(S.SERIE) FROM TGFSER S INNER JOIN TGFITE I ON I.SEQUENCIA=S.SEQUENCIA AND I.NUNOTA=S.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFCAB C ON C.NUNOTA=S.NUNOTA WHERE S.SERIE=SER.SERIE AND C.TIPMOV = 'F') = 2 THEN 'Apontada ate o setor de solda' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(S.SERIE) FROM TGFSER S INNER JOIN TGFITE I ON I.SEQUENCIA=S.SEQUENCIA AND I.NUNOTA=S.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFCAB C ON C.NUNOTA=S.NUNOTA WHERE S.SERIE=SER.SERIE AND C.TIPMOV = 'F') = 1 THEN 'Apontada ate o setor de inserção' ELSE 'Serie com apontamento duplo ou Setaup menor' END) AS STATUS FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFSER SER ON SER.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON PRO.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD INNER JOIN TPRIPROC PRC ON PRC.IDIPROC = CAB.IDIPROC INNER JOIN TGFLOC LOC ON ITE.CODLOCALORIG = LOC.CODLOCAL WHERE TRUNC(CAB.DTENTSAI) >= :P_DTENTSAI.INI AND TRUNC(CAB.DTENTSAI) <= :P_DTENTSAI.FIN AND CAB.CODTIPOPER IN (800,802) AND PRO.USOPROD = 'V' AND (:P_CODLOCALORIG IS NULL OR ITE.CODLOCALORIG = :P_CODLOCALORIG) AND (:P_ADNUMPS IS NULL OR CAB.AD_NUMPS = :P_ADNUMPS) AND (:P_NROLOTE IS NULL OR PRC.NROLOTE = :P_NROLOTE) AND (:P_SERIE IS NULL OR SER.SERIE = :P_SERIE)
